title: 辶 walking (走之底)
intro: 辶 wraps around the bottom-left of a character. It is three strokes, a dot, a zigzag and a long flat sweep, and it is written LAST, after the part it holds: for 这, write 文 first, then 辶. Characters with 辶 are about movement, roads, distance and passing time.

ex.p: tā de hàn yǔ jìn bù de hěn kuài
ex.en: His Chinese is improving fast.

ex.p: qǐng jìn
ex.en: Please come in.

ex.p: yuǎn ma
ex.en: Is it far?

ex.p: wǒ yǒng yuǎn bù huì wàng jì nǐ
ex.en: I will never forget you.

ex.zh: 你知道附近有没有地铁站？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào fù jìn yǒu méi yǒu dì tiě zhàn
ex.en: Do you know if there's a subway station nearby?

ex.p: fù jìn yǒu yào diàn ma
ex.en: Is there a pharmacy nearby?

ex.p: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào hěn jìn
ex.en: My home is close to school.

ex.p: wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yī gè lǐ wù
ex.en: I want to give her a present.

ex.zh: 你知道附近有没有地铁站？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào fù jìn yǒu méi yǒu dì tiě zhàn
ex.en: Do you know if there's a subway station nearby?

ex.zh: 他迟到了，所以向老师道歉。
ex.p: tā chí dào le suǒ yǐ xiàng lǎo shī dào qiàn
ex.en: He was late, so he apologized to the teacher.

ex.p: wǒ qù guò zhōng guó
ex.en: I have been to China.

ex.p: nǐ guò lái yī xià wǒ yǒu shì qíng
ex.en: Come over here, I need you for something.

ex.p: duō yùn dòng duì shēn tǐ hǎo
ex.en: Exercising more is good for you.

ex.p: duì bù qǐ wǒ chí dào le
ex.en: Sorry, I'm late.

ex.zh: 他迟到了，所以向老师道歉。
ex.p: tā chí dào le suǒ yǐ xiàng lǎo shī dào qiàn
ex.en: He was late, so he apologized to the teacher.

ex.p: zhè liǎng gè nǐ xuǎn zé nǎ yī gè
ex.en: Of these two, which do you choose?

ex.p: nǐ xuǎn nǎ yī gè
ex.en: Which one do you choose?

ex.p: zhè lǐ de jiāo tōng hěn fāng biàn
ex.en: Getting around here is convenient.

ex.zh: 老师通知我们明天考试。
ex.p: lǎo shī tōng zhī wǒ men míng tiān kǎo shì
ex.en: The teacher told us there's an exam tomorrow.

ex.zh: 我们一边吃饭一边聊天。
ex.p: wǒ men yī biān chī fàn yī biān liáo tiān
ex.en: We chatted while we ate.

ex.p: tā zuò zài wǒ páng biān
ex.en: He's sitting next to me.

ex.zh: 今天在路上遇到了一个老朋友。
ex.p: jīn tiān zài lù shang yù dào le yī gè lǎo péng you
ex.en: I ran into an old friend on the street today.

texts.title: 读一读 · 辶 walking (走之底)

lines.zh: 我家离公司很远，坐地铁要一个小时。
lines.p: wǒ jiā lí gōng sī hěn yuǎn zuò dì tiě yào yī gè xiǎo shí

lines.zh: 昨天早上地铁出了问题，我迟到了半个小时。
lines.p: zuó tiān zǎo shang dì tiě chū le wèn tí wǒ chí dào le bàn gè xiǎo shí

lines.zh: 我一进办公室，就向老板道歉。
lines.p: wǒ yī jìn bàn gōng shì jiù xiàng lǎo bǎn dào qiàn

lines.zh: 老板说：“没关系，交通不好，不是你的问题。”
lines.p: lǎo bǎn shuō méi guān xi jiāo tōng bù hǎo bù shì nǐ de wèn tí

lines.zh: 下班的时候，我在路上遇到了一个老同学，我们一边走一边聊天，很高兴。
lines.p: xià bān de shí hou wǒ zài lù shang yù dào le yī gè lǎo tóng xué wǒ men yī biān zǒu yī biān liáo tiān hěn gāo xìng

qs.q: 坐地铁去公司要多长时间？
下班的时候“我”遇到了谁？

exercises.why: 近 (near) and 进 (enter) sound the same

exercises.q: 我们一边吃饭一力聊天。
exercises.ans: 我们一边吃饭一边聊天。
exercises.why: 力 is only the inside part
尺 is only the sound part

exercises.en: Do you know if there's a subway station nearby?

wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yī gè lǐ wù
exercises.en: I want to give her a present.
